title: Correct DAO Transit E-flag semantics across code, spec, and vectors
description: P1 protocol/security: spec/05-routing.md current /128 profile requires a 20-byte Transit carrying Parent Address with E=0 for node-owned reachability. Python TransitInformation instead treats bit 0x80 (RFC External E) as a parent-presence bit: to_option() sets it whenever parent_address exists, from_option() only parses the parent when set, and then reports external=False. dao_origin_signature valid vectors likewise encode 0x80 while labeling the route self-owned, contradicting the normative authorization model; the 'unsupported E' negative mutates 0x40 (a reserved bit), not E. Encode/parse Parent Address by option length, preserve/reject the actual E bit per profile authorization, regenerate independent vectors with valid E=0 and explicit E=1 rejection, and align all implementations/spec text.
